title: Digital Native Slang, Internet Culture, and Urban Vernacular
grammar: Digital youth vernacular, expressive particles, and informal ellipsis
goal: I can discuss how internet memes, social media, and borrowed anglicisms transform modern Hungarian youth slang.
I can navigate register shifts between digital youth vernacular and formal B2 academic discourse.
I can explain the linguistic adaptability of Hungarian agglutination in assimilating foreign digital terminology.
